ns2:course.label: Art Teaching Seminar
ns2:course.description: This course is designed to provide undergraduates and graduates seeking certification in Art Education the opportunity to develop and evaluate art curricula for Grades Pre-K through 12. Seminar topics include formulating art lessons, strategies to motivate learners, children's artistic development, effective teaching methods, integrating art museum learning, critique, writing, and technology in the lesson planning process, and maintaining an ISBE file for certification in the State of Illinois. This course must be taken in conjunction with ARTE 204. Prerequisite: ARTE 202.
ns2:course.sectionCappArea: Restricted to Admitted Teacher Ed Student students.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Class Materials Fee of $25 required. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
